THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCKADE.title: Rockade
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCKADE.description: At the end of your turn, gain {Block:diff()} Block for each Giant Rock played this combat.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_FORM.title: Rock Form
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_FORM.description: At the start of each turn, add a {IfUpgraded:show:Giant Rock+|Giant Rock} to your hand. Rock cards cost 1 less.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_ARMOR.title: Rock Armor
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_ARMOR.description: Whenever you play a Giant Rock, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ABSOLUTE_ROCK.title: Absolute Rock
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_SLAM.title: Rock Slam
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_SLAM.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Add a Giant Rock to your discard pile. Exhaust.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-HIDDEN_ROCK.title: Hidden Rock
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-HIDDEN_ROCK.descriptio:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] 1 card.
Add a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Giant Rock+|Giant Rock}[/gold] to your hand.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-INEVITABLE_ROCK.title: Inevitable Rock
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-INEVITABLE_ROCK.descri:
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
Add a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Giant Rock+|Giant Rock}[/gold] to your hand.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_FIVE.title: Rock Five
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_FIVE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Add a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Giant Rock+|Giant Rock}[/gold] to your hand.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_CHARGE.title: Rock Charge
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_CHARGE.descriptio:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Next turn, add a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Giant Rock+|Giant Rock}[/gold] to your hand.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_TRAP.title: Rock Trap
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_TRAP.description: Play ALL [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Giant Rock+|Giant Rock}[/gold] cards in your discard pile on the targeted enemy.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ALL_FOR_ROCK.title: All for Rock
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ALL_FOR_ROCK.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Return ALL [gold]Giant Rock[/gold] cards from your discard pile to your hand.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-CREATIVE_ARTIFICIAL_RO: At the start of your turn, add 1 random [gold]Rock[/gold] card to your hand.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_CASTLE.title: Rock Castle
